environment: Disposable Anvil fork, local PostgreSQL (these earlier runs used perago_test; the later dev:fork guard requires perago_fork), real API/Groq planner, local web app, injected EIP-1193 provider backed by an in-process disposable wallet; no chain-97 broadcast.

checks.faucet: refused because the account was funded; owner manually funded the disposable smart account on the fork
checks.passingPolicyRules: 13/13; collapsed by default, inspectable on demand
checks.staleQuote: STALE_QUOTE refused after fork clock advanced 600 seconds; no signature was requested
checks.providerOutage: API_UNREACHABLE displayed during blocked API requests; retry restored the workspace

forkFaucetClaim.environment: Fresh disposable chain-97 Anvil fork; not a live explorer transaction
forkFaucetClaim.receiptStatus: success; transaction recipient and value matched the authenticated owner's derived smart account
forkFaucetClaim.repeatClaim: FAUCET_ALREADY_CLAIMED; claim control disabled after reload

swap.publicReceipt: SUCCEEDED/PASSED; authority consumed; no ERC-8183 job bound on the testnet-demo executor

stake.publicReceipt: SUCCEEDED/PASSED; authority consumed; no ERC-8183 job bound on the testnet-demo executor

forkRevocation.environment: Separate disposable chain-97 Anvil fork browser run with a 60-second worker poll to expose the pre-BEGIN revocation window; not a live explorer transaction
forkRevocation.publicReceipt: REVOKED/NOT_APPLICABLE; begin and execution transactions absent; authority consumed

screenshots: Rerun the corresponding browser command to regenerate ignored files in apps/web/.screenshots/fork-browser, fork-browser-mobile, or fork-browser-revoke; fork hashes are not live explorer evidence.
remainingGate: P7-002 remains open for browser failure-verification, replay, expiry/settlement, and user visual review; P7-003 remains open for a live chain-97 claim.
